one_line: Early Karkota ruler of Kashmir, associated with the rise of the Karkota–Naga royal house in the Srinagar valley.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s, athletic but not bulky, with a poised, kingly bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, sharp jawline, medium-wheat Kashmiri complexion, neatly groomed short beard and moustache, calm intense eyes with slightly arched brows, default expression serious yet composed and benevolent.
appearance.hair: Thick, dark brown hair gathered into a high knot at the back of the crown, partly covered by a fitted conical Kashmiri turban-cap in deep maroon with a narrow gold band at the base and a small central jade-like stone at the forehead.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, knee‑length woollen tunic (angarkha-style) in rich deep green with wrap-over front, narrow gold edging, and subtle woven geometric borders, over close-fitting churidar-style trousers in warm cream; a heavy pashmina-style shawl in muted saffron drapes from his left shoulder across the torso and around the back, with dark red and brown border stripes; on his feet are brown leather boots reaching mid-calf with simple stitched decoration; jewellery is restrained—a short gold necklace with a small serpent motif pendant, a pair of plain gold stud earrings, and a broad gold armlet on his right upper arm engraved with stylised naga scales.
appearance.signature: A debased-gold Kushan–Sharada type royal dinar held between his right fingers, its small round coin clearly visible, while at his left hip hangs a sheathed straight iron sword with a simple crossguard and wooden hilt wrapped in dark leather.

ref_desc: Durlabhavardhana is a late-30s Kashmiri king with an oval wheat-toned face, dark hair in a high knot under a maroon conical cap, deep green tunic, cream trousers, saffron shawl, gold naga jewellery, a sword at his hip, and a gold dinar in hand.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Durlabhavardhana of Kashmir: a dignified late-30s ruler with an oval, medium-wheat complexion face, sharp jawline, straight nose, calm intense eyes, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache. His thick dark brown hair is tied in a high knot at the back of the crown and partially covered by a fitted conical Kashmiri turban-cap in deep maroon, accented with a narrow gold band and a small jade-like stone at the forehead. He wears a rich deep green knee-length woollen angarkha-style tunic with a wrap-over front, narrow gold edging, and subtle woven geometric borders, over close-fitting cream churidar-style trousers. A heavy pashmina-style shawl in muted saffron drapes from his left shoulder across his torso and around his back, with dark red and brown border stripes, and he has mid-calf brown leather boots with simple stitched detail. Show his restrained jewellery: a short gold necklace with a small serpent motif pendant, plain gold stud earrings, and a broad gold armlet on his right upper arm engraved with stylised naga scales. At his left hip hangs a sheathed straight iron sword with a simple crossguard and dark leather-wrapped wooden hilt, and in his right hand he delicately holds a small round debased-gold Kushan–Sharada type royal dinar. Use deep green, saffron, maroon, cream, brown, and gold as the dominant colours, and present him from multiple angles to clearly show face, hair, garments, jewellery, boots, sword, and coin for consistent redrawing.
